NORTHSTAR ROBOTICS Special Meeting Proxy Statement
The Special Meeting of Shareholders will be held on July 15, 2026.
The record date for the special meeting is May 29, 2026.
Proposal 1: Adoption of the merger agreement with Orion Automation Holdings for $18.50 in cash per share. Board recommendation: FOR.
Vote required: affirmative vote of a majority of the outstanding shares entitled to vote.
If the merger is completed, Northstar Robotics common stock will cease trading on Nasdaq.
